verdicts.reason: A breaks the product graphic: the cream circle has come away from the can and sits clipped at the bottom-left edge, so the orange can disappears into the orange background. The headline, 'Out now.' and CTA are fine. B keeps the can-on-circle composite intact, but 'Out now.' is cut off from the headline and squeezed in beside the CTA. The CTA also nearly touches the bottom edge and hangs under the product instead of sitting with the copy, and the right third of the canvas is dead space.
